goal: SSH Bridge Doctor – kapcsolat, környezet és staging smoke-teszt
actions: echo '== Doctor: env check ==' && command -v bash && command -v wp && wp cli version --allow-root || true
echo '== Doctor: identity ==' && hostname && whoami && pwd
echo '== Doctor: ssh pubkeys head ==' && test -f ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && head -n 2 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys || echo 'no authorized_keys'
echo '== Doctor: wp info (staging) ==' && wp --allow-root --path=/home/sharityh/app-staging cli info || true
echo '== Doctor: wp core is-installed (staging) ==' && wp --allow-root --path=/home/sharityh/app-staging core is-installed && echo OK || echo FAIL
echo '== Doctor: staging HOME/SITEURL ==' && wp --allow-root --path=/home/sharityh/app-staging option get home && wp --allow-root --path=/home/sharityh/app-staging option get siteurl
echo '== Doctor: write/read test ==' && echo BRIDGE-OK-$(date +%s) > ~/bridge_doctor_test.txt && tail -n1 ~/bridge_doctor_test.txt
echo '== Doctor: HTTP smoke (APP host) ==' && curl -ILs https://app.sharity.hu/impactshop-staging/ | sed -n '1,8p'
echo '== Doctor: REST smoke (APP host) ==' && curl -ILs https://app.sharity.hu/impactshop-staging/wp-json/impact/v1/total | sed -n '1,8p'
expected: Minden parancs fut; staging HTTP/REST elérhető (200 vagy egyszeri 301 → 200).
